# SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation

From https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip (SHA3-256 `92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`). SQLite is in the public domain.

It's compiled by `package:sqlite3`'s build hook (`source: source` in the root `pubspec.yaml`), so the app ships no downloaded binaries (ADR-0006).
